subject: Model mix & token volumes - follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sophia McCarthy <sophia.mccarthy@atlasretail.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-10T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Recap: model mix & token-volume discussion

Hi Sophia — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and the asks we discussed so your team can confirm: 

Summary from today's discovery call:
- Primary use: in-app assistant for shoppers + post-purchase search reranking and product recommendations.
- Models likely needed: chat (in-app assistant), embeddings (semantic search & recommendations), rerank (product list reranking).
- Target latency SLOs: sub-200ms for assistant short responses (chat), embeddings used offline/batch, rerank per-query <150ms.

Open asks / next steps (please confirm):
1) Monthly token volume estimate (rough ranges are fine) and desired split by model type (chat / embeddings / rerank).
2) Budget range and target unit economics — you mentioned wanting to benchmark to a target $/1M tokens; can you confirm target range?
3) Technical deep-dive with Dev Patel to confirm payload sizes (average prompt + expected response lengths), embedding dims and storage, and any expected long-context sessions.
4) Security/compliance docs — attaching a one-page product summary for your ops team to review.

Attachments: Atlas_Retail_Prod_Summary.pdf (prod flows + metrics we discussed)

Proposed next step: 30-min technical call next week (I can coordinate times) — if you can share volume ranges and a target $/1M tokens ahead of that call, Dev can provide more accurate per-model cost guidance.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Sophia McCarthy <sophia.mccarthy@atlasretail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-10T19:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap: model mix & token-volume discussion

Thanks Marissa — great summary, and appreciated the clarity on SLOs. A few quick numbers from our side (rough estimates while we pull actuals):

- Estimated monthly tokens: ~120,000,000 tokens/month (this includes prompt + response tokens).
- Proposed model mix (by token volume): chat (70% ~84M), embeddings (20% ~24M, mostly offline batch embedding + some real-time similarity calls), rerank (10% ~12M).
- Budget: we're aiming for $900-$1,200 per 1M tokens on average across usage. We understand the per-model unit cost will differ; this is a blended target tied to our CAC constraints.

We'll also need SOC2 evidence and a short security questionnaire completed before procurement review — I'll attach the questionnaire and loop in procurement once we have the technical call scheduled.

Available for a tech call Tue/Wed next week afternoon PT. Thanks —
Sophia McCarthy
Head of Product Ops | Atlas Retail
Sophia.McCarthy@atlasretail.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sophia McCarthy <sophia.mccarthy@atlasretail.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-11T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap: model mix & token-volume discussion

Appreciate the quick numbers, Sophia — this is exactly the level of detail we need to produce a realistic estimate. Two quick clarifications before the tech call: 

- When you say embeddings are ~24M tokens, is that mostly batch embedding generation (e.g., nightly indexing) or continuous real-time embedding per request? That affects our recommended provisioning (batch vs dedicated pool).
- For chat: are the 84M tokens dominated by short prompts (one-shot Q/A) or longer multi-turn sessions? If multi-turn, what's the average context window (in tokens)?

Preliminary unit economics (high-level, ballpark):
- Chat (optimized mix, RV/quantized): $700-$1,100 per 1M tokens depending on model variant and batching.
- Embeddings (batch/offline): $150-$400 per 1M tokens depending on embedding model and vector dims (higher dims = higher cost).
- Rerank (low-latency model): $900-$1,300 per 1M tokens because of tighter latency targets and smaller batches.

Given your blended target $900-$1,200 per 1M, at the current split the blended cost should be in range but will depend on how much of embeddings is offline batch vs real-time. I've attached our pricing guideline draft for reference.

Attachments: redwood_pricing_guideline_v2.pdf

If you confirm the two clarifications above I will get Dev on the calendar — Marcus and I will join for the call to cover pricing and rollout options (dedicated pools or hosted).

Best,
Marissa
From: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>
To: Sophia McCarthy <sophia.mccarthy@atlasretail.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-11T10:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap: model mix & token-volume discussion (tech details)

Hi Sophia — thanks for the context. A few technical questions so I can scope the call and prepare a quick sizing: 

1) Average prompt length (tokens) and average response length for chat (approx). If you have histograms that would be ideal.
2) Are you planning to maintain long chat sessions with >2k tokens of context, or are most sessions 1-3 turns?
3) Embeddings: model family (if known) and embedding dimension. For batch embedding jobs: how often do you re-index?
4) Rerank: what's the typical candidate set size per query (10, 50, 100?) and are you running rerank synchronously in the request path?

Proposed times (PT): Tue 2027-05-13 1:00–1:30pm, Wed 2027-05-14 3:00–3:30pm. I can do both; let me know what works and I'll send a calendar invite with a brief agenda + ask list.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev@redwood.ai
From: Sophia McCarthy <sophia.mccarthy@atlasretail.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Atlas Retail Procurement <procurement@atlasretail.com>
Date: 2027-05-11T12:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap: model mix & token-volume discussion (tech details)

Thanks Dev — quick answers while I pull more precise stats: 
- Chat: avg prompt ~45 tokens, avg response ~75 tokens; most sessions are short 1-3 turns but we have a small percent (~5%) of long sessions up to 2k tokens.
- Embeddings: currently using sentence-transformer family, 768 dims; re-index nightly (batch). Real-time embeddings are rare (~5% of embedding calls).
- Rerank: candidate set typically 50-100, run synchronously in the request path.

Either Tue 1:00pm or Wed 3:00pm works; prefer Tue if possible. Attaching our security questionnaire for pre-proc review.

Attachment: security_questionnaire.pdf

See you Tue — Sophia
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sophia McCarthy <sophia.mccarthy@atlasretail.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Recap: model mix & token-volume discussion

- Dev will walk through provisioning options (batch vs dedicated pools) and expected per-model cost buckets given the numbers you shared.

- We'll also confirm evidence for the SOC2 items in the questionnaire and share any additional docs you need ahead of procurement.

Marissa
